# Tier 1 (CORE) -- the ~100 UG835 commands a real Vivado flow actually uses.
#
# Hand-curated; edit freely. This file is NOT regenerated by tools/extract_ug835.py, so
# upgrading UG835 never clobbers it. VivadoCommandCatalogTest fails if a name here does
# not exist in ug835-index.tsv, which is how a typo or a command renamed by AMD gets caught.
#
# Tier only affects search: CORE entries rank first in searchVivadoCommands. Every tier is
# equally runnable through runVivadoCommand.
#
# One name per line; '#' starts a comment.
